in_marathi.name: Indumukhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's face
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indumukhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Indumukhi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'indu' meaning drop or rain, and 'mukhi' meaning face. This name is considered to be a reference to the goddess Durga, whose countenance is adorned with the moon (indu) on her forehead. The name Indumukhi symbolizes the divine power of the goddess, who protects her devotees from all dangers.
